name: Recessed 3 inch downlight
origin: Mounting ceiling plane center Z=0; white trim below plane, housing above; emits -Z
allowed_variation: Rigid Z rotation and placement only. Change light power per host instance. No nonuniform scaling.
host_requirements: Provide a 3.4 inch ceiling cutout for the 3.336 inch housing (3 inch visible light aperture) and a reserved service space above for the 3.6 inch housing. Do not intersect an opaque slab. Illustrative geometry, not an IC/fire/wet-location rated fixture.
rights: Original project asset; CC BY 4.0; attribution: Homes project contributors
illumination: Low emission diffuser mesh; optional host-owned light via common.lighting_assets.place. Artistic Blender watts, not verified photometry.
